The claimed path-traversal mechanism is a real sandbox-authorization bug: unsanitized plugin.plugin_id becomes the allowed config-directory prefix, so a plugin lacking READ_FILES can open paths under a resolved directory such as ~/.ssh.
Smallest public first writer is single-parent commit 35499f201ae2dc531d1194f6810c953d8b9af78b; parent 31d2bc8c8b5b3ee818d4cd7228ed9f42f9683004 only allowed temp and stdlib paths.
Direct fix 0c7418bab59e80a2b40913d8ad8523e6bbab196b is contained in tag v1.4.0 and in the official PyPI 1.4.0 sdist; PyPI 1.4.0b3 still ships the unsanitized interpolation.
